status: Research and native capability witness; no product backend selected
acceptedSetupPolicy: Explicit preparation downloads may use networking. The app operates with or without a network connection. For offline tests, install the APK, prepare models and data, then enable airplane mode. No product connectivity check or airplane-mode gate is required. Current RC2 still has no networking permission or downloader.

options.name: Native SQLite FTS5 with compressed content shards
options.role: General custom packs and user records
benefits: Explicit SQL control, BM25 and typed metadata
Contentless/external-content indexes can avoid a second searchable-text payload
Shared SQLite/RTREE path is a candidate for OSM
gaps: Requires bundled native SQLite on the probed target
Compression and passage/source identity need an Outpost format
Broad queries still need query-budget, cancellation and memory tests

options.name: ZIM with libzim/Xapian through Android Java bindings
benefits: Compressed corpus and embedded full-text search when available
Android Archive, Searcher, Search and SearchIterator APIs exist
Can return entry paths, snippets, archive IDs and counts without wholesale import
gaps: HTML-to-text section extraction and stable passage citations
Not every archive necessarily has full-text search
No incremental archive updates; replacement peak storage matters
Native libraries, 16 KiB alignment and cache memory need target validation

options.name: Leviathan library
options.role: Entity-oriented CSV, logs and equipment records
benefits: Mapped fields, scoped search, filters and compact cards
Uses bundled SQLite/FTS5 and exposes a Rust library
gaps: Disable cross-entity fallback for applicability-sensitive questions
JSON arrays load in memory; use streaming inputs or prebuilt indexes
Build temp_store=MEMORY and a 256 MiB cache need mobile tuning
Fuzzy group lookup and exact total counting can scale with matches
options.benchmark: Synthetic records on desktop against grep, not a comparison with Outpost or final LLM answer quality

options.name: Tantivy
options.role: Custom large search packs if SQLite reaches a measured bottleneck
benefits: BM25, compressed document store, range filters and mmap directory
gaps: Rust/JNI integration and Android portability are unmeasured here
Segment lifecycle and cache behavior add implementation work
No claimed performance improvement without equal-corpus Android tests

spatialRetrieval.proposal: Use typed OSM rows and a spatial index for region packs; use lexical search to resolve named anchors. Preserve the exact distance calculation and source locators before model narration.
spatialRetrieval.currentLimit: PlaceQueries scans at most 20,000 stored records and 32 million payload characters.

nativeProbe.scope: Android x86_64 CLI only. No APK/JNI integration, ARM run, model execution or real-corpus quality test.
nativeProbe.targetWitness: FTS4 OR query with a pre-ranking 500-candidate cap omits row 10000. FTS5/BM25 returns row 10000 first.
nativeProbe.latency: Recorded host timings include CLI process startup, query, JSON serialization and ADB round trip; not isolated search latency.

provisionalDirection: Federated pack readers: evaluate ZIM for ready-made knowledge, SQLite for private/custom records and spatial OSM data. Leviathan is an entity-record candidate; Tantivy remains a reserve option. Do not require all packs to share one physical storage format.
nextExperiments: Use the same real text corpus and the same query/evidence budget across text backends
Test installed bytes including model, indexes, originals, partial downloads, updates and caches
Test cold and warm p50/p95, cancellation, process memory, source resolution and final answer correctness on Android
Test missing/conflicting data, multilingual terms, record ranges, multiple rows and geographic coverage
Scale selected real packs only after smaller pilot gates pass; do not pad data to reach 20 GB

vectorBudgetExample.note: Excludes graph/search-index overhead, text and metadata; a full vector index is not the initial default.
